paragraphs: From Tralee test centre on Spa Road, move off and take the 1st right to stay on Spa Road
Continue to the end of the road and turn right onto Caher Anne Road
Take the next right into Cluain Ard, a quiet housing estate often used for the reverse or turnabout manoeuvre
Drive to the end of Cluain Ard and turn right, then be ready to perform a U-turn where directed before continuing back out to the left
Retrace your route to the end of Cluain Ard turn left onto Caher Anne Road, and follow it to the junction with O'Rahilly Villas, where you turn right
Continue straight as the road becomes James Street
Take the next right onto Prince's Quay at the Ballyard Roundabout take the slight left exit, follow the road toward the Ballymullen Roundabout, and take the slight left there as well
Continue on and bear left onto Ballymullen Road
Carry straight on as the road becomes Moyderwell, then at the end of the road turn left onto Castle Street Upper
Take the 1st right into McCowen's Lane, then the next right onto Edward Street, which becomes Oakpark Road
Turn left onto Brewery Road and check your mirrors and signals carefully in this busier area
From Brewery Road, drive to the end and turn left onto Rock Street
At the roundabout take the slight left exit onto North Circular Road
Turn right onto Matt Talbot Road take the next left into Saint Joseph's Estate, another common area for estate driving and observation checks
Leaving Saint Joseph's Estate turn left onto Spa Road and continue to the end of the road, where you turn right onto Caher Anne Road to return toward the Tralee test centre
Keep your speed steady, complete a final mirror check, and prepare to pull in safely on the examiner's instruction
